add_static_batching: add static batching to a fairseq2 data pipeline with a fixed batch size
add_length_batching: add length-based batching to a fairseq2 data pipeline using audio sequence lengths
BatchingStrategy_enum: use the BatchingStrategy enum to choose between STATIC or LENGTH batching strategies
create_bucket_sizes: create bucket sizes for length-based batching using fairseq2 create_bucket_sizes utility
bucket_by_length: apply bucket_by_length to a DataPipelineBuilder with computed bucket sizes and a selector
